Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XVI OF 2006
ORDINANCE XVI OF 2006
Khushhali Bank (Amendment) Ordinance 2006
An Ordinance further to amend the Khushhali Bank Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 3rd August, 2006]
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called
the Khushhali Bank (Amendment) Ordinance, 2006.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 20, Ordinance XXXII of 2000

ORDINANCE XVI OF 2006
ORDINANCE XVI OF 2006
Khushhali Bank (Amendment) Ordinance 2006
An Ordinance further to amend the Khushhali Bank Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 3rd August, 2006]
2. Amendment of section 20, Ordinance
XXXII of 2000.---In the
Khushhali Bank Ordinance, 2000 (XXXII of 2000), in section 20 in subsection (2)
for the words "another three years" the words " a similar term or terms" shall be
substituted.
